title: Store demand forecast
proposal: We will use a vendor tool that forecasts weekly demand per store and product from sales history, promotions and weather, so planners can set replenishment orders.
why: Forecasts products, not people. No Annex III area, no transparency trigger.

title: Supplier risk radar
proposal: We develop our own model that rates supplier companies for disruption risk from their financial filings, news and shipping delays.
why: Rates companies, not natural persons. Annex III 5(b) creditworthiness covers natural persons only.

title: Route optimisation
proposal: We buy a routing engine that plans delivery van routes and time windows from orders, traffic and vehicle capacity.
why: Optimises vehicles and routes. Nothing the AI Act singles out.

title: Warehouse task allocation
proposal: We will use a vendor system that allocates picking tasks to warehouse workers based on each worker's pick rate and error history.
why: Allocating tasks to workers based on their individual behaviour is Annex III 4(b).

title: Picker productivity ranking
proposal: We develop a dashboard that monitors each picker's productivity and ranks workers weekly for supervisors.
why: Monitoring and evaluating workers' performance is Annex III 4(b).

title: Driver fatigue camera
proposal: Truck cabin cameras detect driver fatigue from eye closure and head position and sound an alarm to prevent accidents. We buy a vendor tool.
why: Fatigue is a physical state, not an emotion: Recital 18 names drivers' fatigue detection as outside emotion recognition. Vehicle safety rules may still apply.

title: Shipment tracking chatbot
proposal: Customers talk to a chatbot on our website to track shipments and change delivery slots. We use an off-the-shelf model.
why: Art 50(1): people must be told they are talking to an AI.

title: Visual quality inspection
proposal: Cameras on the packing line detect damaged boxes and wrong labels, and divert them for a person to check.
why: Inspects products. No person is assessed.

title: Forklift predictive maintenance
proposal: Sensors on forklifts feed a model that predicts motor and battery failures so maintenance can be planned.
why: Predicts machine failures. Not a safety component as described.

title: Seasonal hiring screener
proposal: We will use a vendor tool to screen CVs and shortlist candidates for seasonal warehouse jobs.
why: Screening and shortlisting candidates is Annex III 4(a).

title: Call-centre mood coaching
proposal: We will use a tool that detects stress and frustration in our logistics call-centre agents' voices to coach them.
why: Inferring emotions of people at work from their voice is banned by Art 5(1)(f) since 2 Feb 2025.

title: B2B credit limits
proposal: We develop a model that sets credit limits for our business customers, which are companies, from their payment history.
why: Annex III 5(b) covers natural persons. Sole traders would be a different answer.
